The University of Scranton Players will present "Somewhere in Between," the organization's first production in the 2026-27 academic year. Performances will be held Sept. 25, 26, 27, and Oct. 2, 3, 4, at the McDade Center for the Literary and Performing Arts.

Life could always be worse, and if you don’t like it, then you can go and make it better. That’s the lesson at the heart of "Somewhere in Between," the first production in The University of Scranton Players' 2026-27 season. [...] "Somewhere in Between," written by Craig Pospisil and directed by Michael O’Steen, MFA, associate professor of English, will play from Sept. 25 to 27 and Oct. 2 to 4, with six performances. The Full Moon in September 2026 — known as the Harvest Moon in the Northern Hemisphere — occurs on Saturday, September 26, 2026, at 16:49 GMT/UTC (12:49 PM EDT). The Moon will be located in the constellation Pisces and appear close to Saturn and Neptune. The lunar disk will look bright and round for several nights, especially on September 25, 26, and 27. [...] If clouds spoil the view on September 26, try the evening before or after. The Moon will look almost equally full on September 25 and 27. In much of the Northern Hemisphere, it will also rise close to sunset on several consecutive evenings — the characteristic viewing advantage of a Harvest Moon.
